source: List of Ahmedabad Durga Puja 2026 (community poster, assets/reference/pandal_list.jpg)
about: Names and addresses are transcribed as printed on the poster, with its status remarks moved into notes. Coordinates, descriptions and images are null, and timings are null unless the poster states them. No location has been verified. Since then, locations have been pinned (see each record's "verification"). On 2026-10-12 every pandal gained a description: "descriptionBasis" says whether it draws on the published sources listed in "descriptionSources" or only on the poster and general Durga Puja traditions. "schedule" holds hours from the poster or organisers; pandals without real hours get a tentative "planningCutoff" instead, which is a planning aid, never a closing time.

Hall pujos have an intimate, neighbourly feel, and the Puja days follow a familiar rhythm: the Goddess is welcomed on Shashthi, offered anjali on Ashtami morning and bid a tearful farewell on Bijoya Dashami. It makes a convenient stop if your darshan route takes you north towards the airport.

pandals.description: Naroda Kalibari, listed with the All Gujarat Resurgent Trust, keeps its puja at Diamond Park, opposite the Toyota showroom in Naroda, in eastern Ahmedabad. In Bengal a kalibari is a home of Maa Kali, and the Durga Puja calendar there traditionally runs from the nabapatrika bath on Saptami to Sandhi Puja, the sacred moment where Ashtami meets Navami. The Toyota showroom is the easiest landmark to look for on the way.
